1) 从告警标签取 container_name，执行 docker inspe: 1) Take container_name from the alert labels and run docker inspect --format '{{json .State.Health}}' <container> to see the output of the last few health checks; 2) Run docker logs --tail 200 <container> to locate the application error; 3) Reproduce the health check by hand (docker exec <container> <health check command>) to tell an application failure apart from a wrongly written check; 4) If the application is broken and cannot be fixed quickly, first remove the instance from the upstream load balancer, then investigate.

1) Take container_name from the alert labels and run docker inspect <container> | grep -i memory to confirm the current limit; 2) Compare with the historical peak of docker_container_mem_max_usage to tell a too-small limit apart from an application memory leak; 3) If the limit is too small, raise --memory and recreate the container; 4) If a leak is suspected, capture a heap profile on the application side (jmap for Java, pprof for Go) instead of just raising the limit to hide the problem.

1) Take container_name from the alert labels and run docker inspect <container> | grep -iE 'cpuquota|cpuperiod|nanocpus' to confirm the current quota; 2) Compare with docker_container_cpu_usage_percent to tell a traffic increase apart from a busy loop in the application; 3) If traffic grew, raise --cpus and recreate the container, or scale out to several instances; 4) If usage looks abnormal, capture a CPU profile on the application side to find the hot functions.
1) 从告警标签取 container_name，执行 docker logs: 1) Take container_name from the alert labels and run docker logs --tail 200 <container> to see the error before each exit; 2) Run docker inspect --format '{{.State.ExitCode}}' <container> to read the exit code (137 usually means OOM or killed; 1 or 2 usually means the application failed to start); 3) For configuration or dependency problems (cannot reach the database, missing config file), fix the dependency before starting it again; 4) To keep the restart loop from filling the disk with logs, docker stop the container and remove it from the load balancer while you investigate.
1) 从告警标签取 container_name，执行 docker stats: 1) Take container_name from the alert labels and run docker stats --no-stream <container> to confirm current usage against the limit; 2) Check the history curve to tell a steady climb (likely a leak) apart from a normal traffic peak; 3) For normal peaks, raise --memory leaving 20% headroom and recreate the container; 4) For a steady climb, capture a heap profile on the application side to find the leak, and raise the limit meanwhile to buy investigation time.
1) 登录主机执行 systemctl status docker 确认 dae: 1) Log in to the host and run systemctl status docker to confirm the daemon is alive; 2) Run docker ps to verify by hand — if it hangs without returning, the daemon is stuck, use journalctl -u docker -n 200 to locate the cause; 3) Confirm the permissions on /var/run/docker.sock match the collector account; 4) Confirm the disk (especially the partition holding /var/lib/docker) is not full, a full disk is a common cause of a stuck daemon.
Docker 容器内存使用率逼近上限: Docker container memory approaching its limit
容器 10 分钟内重启超过 3 次，已进入崩溃重启循环，服务实际处于不可用状态且: The container restarted more than 3 times in 10 minutes and is now in a crash-restart loop; the service is effectively unavailable and keeps consuming host resources.
容器内存使用率已连续 5 分钟超过 limit 的 90%，再涨就会被 OOM: Container memory usage has stayed above 90% of its limit for 5 minutes; any further growth will get it killed by the OOM killer.
容器因超出内存限制被内核 OOM Killer 杀掉，进程内的请求全部中断，未持: The container exceeded its memory limit and was killed by the kernel OOM killer; all in-flight requests were dropped and unpersisted data is lost.
容器的 HEALTHCHECK 已连续 3 分钟返回失败，容器进程虽在但对外不可: The container HEALTHCHECK has been failing for 3 minutes; the process is still running but the container is not serving, and the orchestrator may be about to recreate it.
容器超过 25% 的 CPU 调度周期被限流，说明 CPU quota 已经不够: More than 25% of the container's CPU scheduling periods are being throttled, which means the CPU quota is no longer sufficient and application latency will rise noticeably.
采集端已连续 1 分钟连不上 Docker daemon，该宿主机上所有容器的状: The collector has not been able to reach the Docker daemon for 1 minute; status and resource data for every container on this host is lost and orchestration operations will fail.
